messages:
aline: Kicking off throughput + tail-latency run for NovaHealth POC. Need runbook + cost estimate for execs. Starting 9AM PT tomorrow. Can people confirm plan?

jules: I'm good. Quick Qs: which model? seq len / prompt+gen tokens? Target sustained qps and peak burst?

aline: Model: redwood/ggml-7B-v1 (quantized). Avg prompt 80 tokens, gen 120 tokens. Target sustained 35 qps, spikes to ~180 qps for ~3s every minute.

mike: OK. We'll run a mixed synthetic load: 75% short chats (20/40 tokens), 25% long-gen (80/120). Plan: smoke -> soak -> burst -> tail-latency sweep. Steps:
1) Smoke single replica cold start (check cold p95)
2) Single node soak 30m at 35 qps (stability, mem growth)
3) Scale to multi-replica and execute controlled bursts to 180 qps (observe autoscale)
4) Tail-latency sweep: p99/p99.9 over 60m windows

Commands (example):
```bash
# steady-state soak
k6 run --vus 35 --duration 30m script.js
# burst test (gated)
k6 run --vus 180 --duration 10m burst.js
```
Metrics to capture: p50/p95/p99/p99.9, GPU util, GPU mem, CPU, pod restart counts, request queue depth, cache hit rate.

jules: Add prefix-caching variant: run identical prompt sequence to measure cache delta. Also test quant profiles (q8_0 vs q4_0) if available.

tim: For the execs: pricing one-liner we can drop in the deck? Need a ballpark hosted vs reserved estimate.

mike: Ballpark hosted cost for this model/quant: ~$0.013 per 1k tokens. Rough calc: avg tokens/request = prompt+gen = 200 tokens. Sustained 35 qps => 7,000 tokens/sec => 25,200,000 tokens/hr. At $0.013 / 1k => cost/hr ≈ $327.6. Dedicated/reserved capacity often ~30–50% cheaper depending on commit. Will refine after we collect real token counts from the run.

aline: Can we get a short ops checklist I can hand to the prospect? Need things they can tick off pre-run.

mike: Checklist:
- confirm exact model commit hash and quant config
- pre-warm cache with ~5k warmup requests
- set autoscale policy min_replicas=1 max_replicas=12 (adjust as needed)
- enable request tracing and collect any traces >2s
- enable kv/prefix cache metric collection
- snapshot console graphs at 5/30/60m marks
- ensure logging retention policy applied (see tim)

ops-bot: Deploy pipeline: perf-env -> cluster-3b deployed redwood/ggml-7B-v1 @ 1766123400 by mike

jules: I'll draft a 1-page runbook + results template (sections: test params, environment, raw metrics, analysis, cost calc, risks). Will post in #sales by EOD.

tim: FYI forwarding prospect security questionnaire. Key Q: data retention and redaction. They want confirmation for logs + payloads.

mike: Confirmed: request logs/metrics retained 30 days by default. Payload retention is disabled by default; full payloads can be stored for 7d on request or 0d for stricter enterprises. We can enable KMS-backed keys and restrict access for Private deployments.

aline: Great. I'll schedule the run and loop in procurement. I'll post start/end times and tag who runs collection.

jules: One more tuning suggestion: enable prefix cache for this workload and set max_batch_tokens ~2048 to reduce per-token overhead. Also consider increasing KV cache size during burst window. :+1:

aline: noted — will run with that config.

mike: I'll own data collection and the final cost calc. Ping me when the run starts and when we hit the first burst.

aline: Thanks all — will update here. :rocket:
